integrity: The claims follow from explicit recurrences, binary digit induction, exact transfer identities and the square-root block bound. The supplied standalone checker reproduces finite tests; independent scientific validation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Only modulus 8 is classified, with no exact optimal global error constant or higher-power extension. Nonindexed earlier work and more general automatic-sequence results remain bibliographic risks. Finite software checks are not proofs of infinite assertions.
title: A sharp modulo-eight distribution law for the semi-Pell sequence
